name: Finnmark FD-7 Infrared Barrel Sauna
description: Finnmark Infrared and Traditional 6x6 Outdoor Barrel, Thermo-Aspen Explore the FD-7, a premium Thermo-Aspen barrel sauna that integrates Finnmark’s patented UL-listed Spectrum Plus™ infrared panels with a classic Finnish rock sauna. Designed to comfortably accommodate up to four individuals, it offers a superior and versatile sauna experience. The Ultimate Cedar Sauna Experience — Traditional Heat Meets Advanced Infrared Experience the premier cedar combination barrel sauna that seamlessly integrates infrared and traditional heating for an unparalleled wellness session. With temperatures reaching up to 185°F, indulge in the revitalizing practice of pouring water over heated stones to create a dense, soothing steam, while enjoying the therapeutic effects of deep-penetrating infrared heat. This sauna represents the height of luxurious relaxation. Crafted for Excellence Every detail of this sauna reflects premium craftsmanship and thoughtful design. Built with thick, 1.5” full-length Thermo-Aspen staves, it offers unmatched beauty, durability, and a naturally aromatic ambiance. Dual-level benches and backrests, also crafted from Canadian Cedar, are naturally antimicrobial and satin-smooth, remaining cool to the touch even in high heat. Stunning Design, Built to Last An 8 mm-thick tempered glass door and window panels create an open, upscale aesthetic while providing lasting strength. A complete shingle kit ensures your sauna stays dry and protected, no matter the weather. Get Hot, Fast — Inside and Out Equipped with Finnmark Spectrum Plus™ Infrared Heaters, this sauna delivers both mid- and far-infrared waves that penetrate deeply into muscles and joints, triggering up to 25 times more sweat than standard carbon heaters. Choose your traditional 4.5kW heater for fast, powerful heat and satisfying steam. Smart Features for Effortless Comfort Relax and unwind with intuitive technology at your fingertips: an LCD Wi-Fi-enabled control panel offers remote operation, while built-in under-bench RGB lighting lets you set the perfect mood every time Includes Under-bench LED RGB light Slats Front Trim Front Panel Back Panel Metal Bands Metal Bands Clamps Shingles Insulating Layer Male Light Cable Handle Outdoor Power Cover Screw Cover Power Cord Basic Level Pencil Necessary fasteners Drain Features Spectrum Plus™ UL Listed short-wave infrared heaters for deep penetrating heat, up to 25x more than standard carbon panel heaters. This means that we have received your order in our system and pre-authorized your credit card for the purchase. As soon as we receive your order, we automatically reach out to our suppliers to confirm that it is in stock and available for immediate shipment. If your item is on backorder or unavailable, we will void the pre-authorization and reach out to you via e-mail. If your item(s) are available for immediate shipment (within 5 business days), we will process the charges and submit the order for shipment. When will my order ship? If your order is in stock and we process the charges to your credit card, it will ship within five business days from the date of your order. We will send you tracking information within 24 hours of your order leaving the warehouse to the e-mail address you provided when checking out. If you do not receive tracking information from us within six business days of your order, feel free to follow up with us at customercare@nordicasauna.com . No shipping outside the lower 48 States in the USA. What if my shipment is damaged? Please inspect the packaging of your item(s) when they arrive. If you notice any damage, you should make note of it when signing for delivery. If your item(s) do arrive damaged please send photos to customercare@nordicasauna.com and we will process an insurance claim on your behalf. Cancellations (Before order ships) Nordica Sauna prides itself on having one of the best return policies in the industry. Reach agents during business hours at 1-877-587-5387, the chat on our website, or email customercare@nordicasauna.com Cancellations of customer orders Custom or made to order products cannot be canceled or refunded as these products are put into production specifically for your order. These units are custom made to your specification or created once you order. Once you place your order they start building your unit. Your warranty will guarantee you a fully functional and operational product. If it is not clear whether your order is custom or made to order, please message or call us. All sales are final for Custom made and Made-to-order products. Refunds & Returns If you need to exchange your product, you may do so. You, as the customer, are responsible for any shipping costs throughout any returns or exchange processes. Not all orders are available for return once they have shipped. We order products directly from the manufacturer. Therefore, if the manufacturer will not permit us to return a product, we cannot offer you a return. This often varies on a case-by-case basis; please reach out to us if you would like specific information on your brand and/or product. Due to drastically increasing LTL/freight shipping costs, any outright returns will incur a 25% cancellation fee + return shipping costs. If you are replacing the product with something else, we may be able to help you cover some of the costs depending on the product. Seller reserves the right to refuse to refund any deposit or payment, or cancel any payment due, and any owing until such time as Seller a) is in receipt of the goods b) has inspected the goods and c) in the Sellers discretion, has found the goods to be free of damage. All refunds will be provided within 5 business days once the product has been returned to the warehouse and inspected for damage. Shipping Times We promise to do our best to get your order to you as soon as possible.
